Kim, J., Sovacool, B.K., Bazilian, M., Griffiths, S., Lee, J., Yang, M. and Lee, J. (2022). Decarbonizing the iron and steel industry: A systematic review of sociotechnical systems, technological innovations, and policy options. Energy Research & Social Science 89, 102565. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.erss.2022.102565

This is a sociotechnical systematic review; contrary to to-get ("compiled tables of cost, TRL and emissions for ~50 technologies") it has NO technology table with energy, cost or TRL numbers. Table 6 classifies 86 innovations into three maturity bands (commercial but not widely used / prototypes / experimental after 2025) with Table A1 descriptions. Loaded: description + state-of-development (mapped: commercial / demonstration / research) for the 20 innovations that are whole technologies matching archetypes, plus one reprinted number (H2-DRI up to 91% direct CO2 reduction vs NG-DRI, Rechberger 2020). Measures file: Table 7 cost savings (USD/t, reprinted from Worrell et al. 2003, price year not stated) and recuperative burner 10-20% fuel. Other-values: Table 4 global final energy 2015, typical plant CO2, China case, slag heat recovery, hydrogen cost, etc. Not loaded: the ~65 other Table 6 items (measures, practices, recycling, policy), Tables 1-3, 5, 8-10 (production statistics, LCA of vehicles, policy). Page numbers are printed journal pages (= PDF pages). Traps: HYBRIT saving printed as 24-32 kg CO2 per ton H2 (units implausible).
